text: Improve discoverability of uncommitted ideas (so the autonomous loop finds all open work, not just phase-committed)
description: Found via Felix's hunch: 60 of 81 open ideas (74%) are not committed to any phase yet all have parents, so they were invisible to every discovery path — get_prioritized_ideas only ranks phase-committed ideas, and the `floating` filter requires no-phase AND no-parents. Fixed in commit ca20f0e: added an `uncommitted` filter (backend idea.list + MCP list_ideas), an `uncommittedOpen` section in graph_hygiene, and pointed get_prioritized_ideas/list_ideas/graph_hygiene descriptions at it + commit_idea_to_phase. Remaining: triage the existing ~60 uncommitted open ideas into phases (judgment per idea — left for incremental/human triage now that they're findable).

reflections.context: Felix's hunch that uncommitted ideas weren't being returned by the loop's discovery tools. The prioritized-ideas loop kept surfacing only vague container ideas.
reflections.outcome: Proved with data: 60/81 open ideas (74%) are unphased-but-parented — invisible because get_prioritized_ideas needs a phase and the floating filter needs no-parents. Added an `uncommitted` filter + graph_hygiene uncommittedOpen section + description nudges (ca20f0e, tested).
reflections.effectiveness: High: a single missing filter dimension was hiding three-quarters of open work from an autonomous loop whose whole premise is finding work. Cheap fix, large unblock.
reflections.lesson: When an autonomous loop 'runs out of work', suspect the DISCOVERY query before concluding the backlog is empty. Two near-synonymous concepts (no-phase vs no-parents) were conflated in one filter, creating a blind spot exactly where most ideas live.

status.comment: Tooling shipped in ca20f0e with tests. Backlog triage of the ~60 existing uncommitted ideas is now possible via list_ideas uncommitted=true / graph_hygiene uncommittedOpen.
